Same for this – go for a simpler approach so the compiler can optimise to a single instruction.

> Clang converts your code to `bswap` or `movebe` depending on the target x86 architecture, but gcc 15.2 does not, according to [this godbolt link](https://c.godbolt.org/z/EKdrhGKjj). Note that alternative does, and is simpler.

Alright, will do, thanks! I assume this should also be done for the LE versions as well, since those use the same approach?
Instead of manual byte manipulations, there are `BSWAP64`/`BSWAP32`/`BSWAP16` macros which directly translate to compiler built-in function (`__builtin_bswap*`) if possible.
